title: Executable instantiation soundness assembled from per-component lemmas
intent: Prove that the executable instantiation interp_instantiate implies the relational instantiate by unfolding the relation into its conjuncts and discharging each with one soundness lemma per component (module type checker, external type checker, allocator, global and element initialisers, plus the bit-level type-checker reflection), so the headline theorem is a 157-line glue of asserts and specializes.

parent.name: interp_instantiate_imp_instantiate
parent.statement:
Lemma interp_instantiate_imp_instantiate : forall hs hs' s m v_imps s_end f bes str,
  interp_instantiate hs s m v_imps = (Some (hs', s_end, f, bes), str) ->
  instantiate s m v_imps (s_end, f, bes).

children.name: module_type_checker_sound
children.statement:
Lemma module_type_checker_sound: forall m t_imps t_exps str,
  module_type_checker m = (Some (t_imps, t_exps), str) ->
  module_typing m t_imps t_exps.
children.closed_by: its own proof: destruct m and each sub-checker with eqn:, unfold module_typing, then repeat split with one { ... } block per component; the func/global/elem/data blocks close via b_e_type_checker_reflects_typing
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: if the executable module type checker accepts m then m is well-typed (module_typing m t_imps t_exps)

children.statement:
Lemma external_type_checker_sound: forall s ext t,
  external_type_checker s ext = Some t ->
  external_typing s ext t.
children.closed_by: destruct ext; destruct t => //; remove_bools_options; subst
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: if the executable external type checker returns t then external_typing s ext t

children.name: interp_alloc_sound
children.statement:
Lemma interp_alloc_sound: forall s m v_imps g_inits r_inits s' inst,
  length g_inits = length m.(mod_globals) ->
  length r_inits = length m.(mod_elems) ->
  interp_alloc_module s m v_imps g_inits r_inits = (s', inst) ->
  alloc_module s m v_imps g_inits r_inits (s', inst).
children.closed_by: its own proof: unfold interp_alloc_module/alloc_module, destruct each alloc_*, then apply alloc_func_iota_N, alloc_table_iota_N, alloc_mem_iota_N, alloc_global_iota_N, alloc_elem_iota_N, alloc_data_iota_N
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: if interp_alloc_module returns (s', inst) then alloc_module s m v_imps g_inits r_inits (s', inst), given the two length preconditions

children.name: module_typecheck_glob_aux
children.statement:
Lemma module_typecheck_glob_aux: forall m t_imps t_exps str,
    module_type_checker m = (Some (t_imps, t_exps), str) ->
    exists c, all (module_global_type_checker c) m.(mod_globals).
children.closed_by: unfold module_type_checker; destruct m; remove_bools_options; by eexists; eauto
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: a successful module type check yields a context c under which every global's init expression type-checks

children.name: b_e_type_checker_reflects_typing
children.statement:
Lemma b_e_type_checker_reflects_typing:
  forall C bes tf,
    reflect (be_typing C bes tf) (b_e_type_checker C bes tf).
children.closed_by: its own proof: destruct (b_e_type_checker C bes (Tf tn tm)), then the ReflectT and ReflectF directions
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: the executable b_e_type_checker reflects be_typing

children.name: alloc_func_iota_N
children.statement:
Lemma alloc_func_iota_N modfuncs ws inst ws' l:
  alloc_funcs ws modfuncs inst = (ws', l) ->
  l = iota_N (length (s_funcs ws)) (length modfuncs) /\
  ws'.(s_funcs) = ws.(s_funcs) ++ map (fun mf => gen_func_instance mf inst) modfuncs /\
  ws.(s_tables) = ws'.(s_tables) /\
  ws.(s_mems) = ws'.(s_mems) /\
  ws.(s_globals) = ws'.(s_globals) /\
  ws.(s_elems) = ws'.(s_elems) /\
  ws.(s_datas) = ws'.(s_datas).
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: alloc_funcs returns the address list iota_N (length (s_funcs ws)) (length modfuncs) and appends the generated function instances to the store

children.name: alloc_global_iota_N
children.statement:
Lemma alloc_global_iota_N modglobals g_inits ws ws' l:
  alloc_globs ws modglobals g_inits = (ws', l) ->
  length g_inits = length modglobals ->
  l = iota_N (length (s_globals ws)) (length modglobals) /\
  ws.(s_funcs) = ws'.(s_funcs) /\
  ws.(s_tables) = ws'.(s_tables) /\
  ws.(s_mems) = ws'.(s_mems) /\
  ws'.(s_globals) = ws.(s_globals) ++ map (fun '({| modglob_type := gt; modglob_init := ge |}, v) => {| g_type := gt; g_val := v |} ) (List.combine modglobals g_inits) /\
  ws.(s_elems) = ws'.(s_elems) /\
  ws.(s_datas) = ws'.(s_datas).
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: alloc_globs returns the address list iota_N (length (s_globals ws)) (length modglobals) and appends the generated global instances, given length g_inits = length modglobals

applicability.goal_shape: A soundness theorem relating an executable, option-returning pipeline (interp_instantiate hs s m v_imps = Some (hs', s_end, f, bes)) to a relational specification (instantiate s m v_imps (s_end, f, bes)) whose definition is an existential over witnesses plus a conjunction of component obligations.
applicability.use_when: The relational specification is a fixed set of conjuncts (module_typing, external_typing, import_subtyping, alloc_module, instantiate_globals, instantiate_elems, ...) that can each be stated and proved as its own soundness lemma; each executable step already has a corresponding relational component, and the witnesses can be read off the executable run.
applicability.avoid_when: A single component's soundness needs the intermediate state of another component (then the lemmas are not self-contained); the executable and relational versions diverge in structure so the witnesses cannot be extracted by destruct; the obligations are not a fixed finite list.

consequences: The move creates one obligation per conjunct of the instantiate relation, each closed by a named lemma. Five of the eight shown children are small or moderate (8, 12, 12, 26, 38 lines); module_type_checker_sound (159 lines) and b_e_type_checker_reflects_typing (84 lines) are the real content, and the initialiser conjuncts are the hard part because the executable version computes initialiser values under a smaller context than the relational one (the file header calls it 'breaking circularities in the evaluation of various initialisers'). The glue's exists ... ; repeat split fixes the witness order to match the instantiate definition, so a child must discharge exactly its conjunct; if a conjunct needs state from a sibling, the split fails. Failure mode: the six alloc_*_iota_N lemmas are near-duplicates generated per store component, so the decomposition buys width, not depth, and a new store component requires a new near-identical lemma.
